hero.tagline: Some places you visit. Others, you feel, by reconnecting with yourself, others, and the world around you.

snorkeling-diving.name: Snorkeling & Diving
snorkeling-diving.description: Experience world-class marine life at Batu Bolong, Manta Point, and vibrant coral gardens teeming with fish.
snorkeling-diving.overview: Drift through nutrient-rich currents, swim alongside massive manta rays, and marvel at the kaleidoscope of coral reefs that make Komodo a diver's dream.
snorkeling-diving.whatYoullDo: Snorkel with mantas, dive iconic sites like Castle Rock, and explore the underwater wonders of the Coral Triangle.
snorkeling-diving.bestTime: April to December for the best visibility; mantas are year-round but gather in larger numbers during plankton seasons.
snorkeling-diving.notes: Currents can be strong; guided sessions ensure safety. fins and masks provided.

dragon-trekking.name: Dragon Trekking
dragon-trekking.description: Walk with legends. Guided treks on Rinca and Komodo Islands to see the world's largest lizard in its natural habitat.
dragon-trekking.overview: A ranger-led adventure through savannah and monsoon forests to safely observe Komodo dragons and other island wildlife.
dragon-trekking.whatYoullDo: Trek scenic trails, spot dragons, water buffalo, and deer, and learn about the park's unique ecology from expert rangers.
dragon-trekking.bestTime: Early morning or late afternoon when dragons are most active.
dragon-trekking.notes: Stay with your ranger at all times. Bring water, hat, and sturdy shoes.

hiking-viewpoints.name: Hiking & Viewpoints
hiking-viewpoints.description: Scale the heights of Padar and Gili Laba for iconic panoramic views of crescent bays and turquoise waters.
hiking-viewpoints.overview: Sunrise treks that reward you with breathtaking vistas of the archipelago's rugged landscape and contrasting beaches.
hiking-viewpoints.whatYoullDo: Hike up stone steps to Padar's summit, capture the famous three-bay photo, and enjoy golden hour from high above.
hiking-viewpoints.bestTime: Sunrise is magical for Padar; cooler temperatures and stunning light.
hiking-viewpoints.notes: Moderate fitness required for Padar. Bring water and sunscreen.

pink-beach-relaxation.name: Pink Beach Relaxation
pink-beach-relaxation.description: Unwind on rare rose-hued sands created by crushed red coral, contrasting vividly with fantastic blue water.
pink-beach-relaxation.overview: A surreal beach experience where you can swim, sunbathe, and snap incredible photos of the unique pink shoreline.
pink-beach-relaxation.whatYoullDo: Picnic on the beach, snorkel the near-shore reef, and marvel at the pink sand grains under your feet.
pink-beach-relaxation.bestTime: Mid-day for the brightest colors, or sunset for a soft glow.
pink-beach-relaxation.notes: Please do not take sand home. Leave nature as you found it.

island-hopping.name: Island Hopping
island-hopping.description: Sail between craggy islands, discovering hidden lagoons, sandbars like Taka Makassar, and secluded coves.
island-hopping.overview: The joy of the journey itself—feeling the sea breeze, watching flying fish, and anchoring in pristine turquoise bays.
island-hopping.whatYoullDo: Visit Taka Makassar sandbar, explore Kalong Island at dusk, and cruise past dramatic coastal cliffs.
island-hopping.bestTime: All day; the changing light transforms the seascape constantly.
island-hopping.notes: Sun protection is essential on the open deck.

sunset-bats.name: Sunset with Bats
sunset-bats.description: Witness thousands of Flying Foxes migrate at dusk from the mangroves of Kalong Island—a natural spectacle.
sunset-bats.overview: Anchor near the mangroves as the sky turns purple and watch endless streams of fruit bats fill the air.
sunset-bats.whatYoullDo: Relax on the boat deck with a sundowner drink and watch the mesmerizing migration.
sunset-bats.notes: Quiet observation creates the best atmosphere.

stargazing.name: Stargazing
stargazing.description: Drift into sleep under a canopy of stars. Far from city lights, the Milky Way shines bright over the Flores Sea.
stargazing.overview: Peaceful nights on the boat or at your remote resort, looking up at the southern sky.
stargazing.whatYoullDo: Identify constellations, spot shooting stars, and enjoy the absolute silence of the ocean.
stargazing.bestTime: New moon nights for the darkest skies.
stargazing.notes: Bring a light jacket for the cool sea breeze.

localCommunityPage.heroDescription: Where warm greetings meet rich traditions. Step into everyday moments near Labuan Bajo and the islands.

village-walks.title: Mesa Island Village
village-walks.body: Walk the paths of Mesa Island, a settlement of sea gypsies living on the reef. See how they utilize the ocean for everything from food to building materials.

sea-gypsy.title: Fish Market Buzz
sea-gypsy.body: Visit the local market in Labuan Bajo where the daily catch arrives. It's a vibrant hub of commerce and conversation.

shared-meals.title: Traditional Flores Meals
shared-meals.body: Share a meal prepared with local spices and fresh ingredients. Food is the universal language of hospitality here.

respectful-photos.title: Weaving & Crafts
respectful-photos.body: Discover the intricate ikat weaving traditions of Flores. Each pattern tells a story of heritage and identity.

wildlife.title: Where to meet the wild
wildlife.description: Encounter the extraordinary biodiversity of Komodo National Park. From majestic manta rays to ancient sea turtles, vibrant reef fish to the legendary Komodo dragon – discover wildlife both above and below the water.

wildlifeIntro.description: From manta rays and sea turtles to the legendary Komodo dragon, these islands hold rare encounters. Discover what to look for, when to go, and how to observe responsibly.

trekking-with-dragons.title: Trekking with Dragons: A Ranger's Guide
trekking-with-dragons.excerpt: Walking on Rinca Island offers a glimpse into a prehistoric world. Learn how to safely observe the legendary Komodo Dragon with our expert park rangers.
trekking-with-dragons.content: A trek on Rinca is unlike any other. The dry savannah heat, the rustle of lontar palms, and the knowledge that you are sharing the path with an apex predator. Our rangers are your eyes and ears, trained to spot dragonscamouflaged in the shade. Always follow their instructions, stay on the path, and keep your distance. seeing a dragon in the wild is a privilege that demands respect.

magic-of-manta-point.title: The Magic of Manta Point: Swimming with Giants
magic-of-manta-point.excerpt: Drifting over the cleaning stations of Komodo, you might find yourself eye-to-eye with a graceful Manta Ray. Here is what makes this encounter so special.
magic-of-manta-point.content: Manta Point is a gathering place. Here, currents bring plankton, and cleaner fish wait on coral heads. Reef Mantas arrive to feed and be cleaned. For snorkelers, the rule is passive observation. Don't chase. Let them come to you. When a 3-meter ray glides just beneath you, curiosity in its eyes, time stands still.

sunrise-at-padar.title: Sunrise at Padar: The Iconic Climb
sunrise-at-padar.excerpt: The hike is steep, but the reward is legendary. Witnessing the sun rise over Padar Island's three colored bays is a photographer's dream.
sunrise-at-padar.content: Start in the dark. The stone steps wind up the spine of the island. As the sky lightens, the shapes reveal themselves—white sand, black sand, and pink sand bays curved back-to-back. At the summit, the sun breaks the horizon, flooding the dramatic landscape with golden light. It is the defining image of Komodo, and earning it with a morning sweat makes it even sweeter.

block1.description1: Komodo is more than dragons. The people of Manggarai and the coastal villages have a rich culture. Meet the welcoming locals in Labuan Bajo or the brave villagers of Komodo Village who have lived alongside dragons for generations.
block1.description2: Let their stories and traditions transform your trip.

block2.title: Discover the traditional ways of island life
block2.description1: From fishing to weaving, traditions run deep here. Witness the daily rhythm of the harbor or visit a weaving cooperative to see ikat being made.
block2.description2: Support local livelihoods through meaningful connection.

block3.title: Create lasting memories
block3.description1: A smile shared in a market, a conversation with a boat captain—these are the moments that stick.
block3.description2: Be a guest, not just a tourist.

boatSection.sectionTitle: In the details: Boat Safety & Experience
boatSection.contentDescription: We travel unhurried. More sea, more silence, more care. These are the essentials that make every KomodoVoyage journey safe, comfortable, and deeply personal.

boatCabins.title: Boat, Cabins & Shared Space
boatCabins.description: Comfort-first layout with shaded lounging, breezy cabins, and social corners. Room to stretch out, read, nap, and gather without feeling crowded.

safety.title: Safety On Board
safety.description: Safety-first routines, clear briefings, and well-maintained gear. You can relax fully knowing every detail is planned and checked.

crew.title: The Crew & Your Captain
crew.description: A calm, capable captain and warm crew who anticipate needs. They guide, help, and host with genuine care from start to finish.

rhythm.title: Daily Rhythm & Atmosphere
rhythm.description: A smooth, flexible flow shaped around weather and energy. Sunrise starts, slow afternoons, and golden-hour stops that feel right each day.

cuisine.title: Fresh Cuisine
cuisine.description: Fresh, flavorful meals prepared with attention. Local ingredients, balanced options, and thoughtful touches that make dining onboard simple and satisfying.

purpose.title: Travel With Purpose
purpose.description: Travel that gives back through respectful local partnerships and mindful routes. Small choices that support communities and protect the reefs we all come to love.

boat.heroDescription: Discover the details that make every journey smooth, safe, and memorable. From our captain's expertise to the quiet comfort of the deck.

safety.title: Safety, without the fuss
safety.body: Clear briefings, reliable life jackets, and calm routines keep everything steady. From weather checks to safe transfers, each step is handled quietly, so you feel confident and free to enjoy the sea.

crew.title: Comfort in shared spaces
crew.body: A shaded lounge, soft seating, and an easy layout make the boat feel like a floating living room. Stretch out, snack, chat, or nap with good airflow and no cramped corners.

comfort.title: Seamanship you can feel
comfort.body: A captain who reads wind, current, and reef color at a glance. Smooth approaches, steady pacing, and smart route choices turn crossings into calm, predictable moments, even in changing conditions.

experience.title: Golden water, slow moments
experience.body: Some of the best memories happen between islands. Reef-blue shallows, glassy mornings, and sunset glides invite you to pause, breathe, and let the ocean set the mood for the day.

boatAndAccommodations.subtitle: Safety, comfort, and island-side rest. Every journey and sleep feels considered.

speed-of-silence.title: The Speed of Silence
speed-of-silence.description: Glide through the archipelago on our premium wooden speedboat. Designed for smooth transfers and sunset cruises.

lounge-horizon.title: Lounge & Horizon
lounge-horizon.description: Shaded comfort, teak decks, and the endless blue. Ideally suited for long lazy days between dives.

safety-service.title: Safety & Service
safety-service.description: Your safety is our ritual. Expert crew, top-tier gear, and genuine care in every interaction.

lagoon-explorer.description: Navigate shallow reefs and hidden lagoons where larger vessels cannot reach. Pure immersion.

howToBooking.pageDescription: We believe in direct connection. All bookings are confirmed personally via WhatsApp or email to ensure your itinerary is perfectly tailored to your needs.
howToBooking.whatsappDescription: The fastest way to secure your spot. We usually reply within an hour during business days. Send us a quick message to check availability.
howToBooking.emailDescription: Prefer a detailed itinerary in your inbox? Send us your requirements and we will craft a custom proposal for you.
howToBooking.paymentDescription: To secure your booking, we typically require a deposit with the remaining balance due closer to your trip date. We accept Bank Transfer and Debit Cards.
howToBooking.paymentNote: Exact payment details and deadlines will be shared in your booking confirmation.
howToBooking.faq1Answer: We aim to reply to all inquiries within 24 hours. For WhatsApp messages during business hours, you can expect a response within an hour.
howToBooking.faq2Answer: Yes, we are flexible. Date changes are subject to availability. Please let us know as soon as possible if you need to reschedule.
howToBooking.faq3Answer: Absolutely. Whether vegetarian, vegan, or allergies, we ensure your meals are safe and delicious. Just mention it when you book.
howToBooking.faq4Answer: We offer both options. Most of our itineraries are private for a personalized experience, but we can also arrange shared trips on request.

manta-ray.intro: Majestic giants of the ocean, Reef Mantas are harmless filter feeders that glide through Komodo's currents.
manta-ray.whereToSee: Manta Point, Makassar Reef, and sometimes Batu Bolong.
manta-ray.howToSpot: Look for dark shapes in the blue or wing tips breaking the surface.

green-sea-turtle.intro: A large, gentle sea turtle often seen resting on shallow reefs or grazing on seagrass.
green-sea-turtle.howToSpot: Look for a shell resting on coral or a head popping up for air.

dugong.intro: The shy 'sea cow', a rare sirenian found grazing in quiet bays.
dugong.whereToSee: Rare; occasionally seen in secluded bays with seagrass.
dugong.howToSpot: Look for sediment plumes or a snout breaking the surface.

komodo-dragon.intro: The undisputed king of the park. A prehistoric monitor lizard found nowhere else on earth.
komodo-dragon.howToSpot: Walk with a ranger; look in shade under trees or buildings.

timor-deer.intro: The primary prey of the Komodo Dragon, these deer are abundant on the main islands.
timor-deer.whereToSee: Grazing on beaches or savannahs of Komodo/Rinca.
timor-deer.howToSpot: Look for large ears and brown coats against green grass.

flying-fox.intro: Large fruit bats that roost in mangroves and migrate in massive flocks at dusk.
flying-fox.howToSpot: Look for the sky filling with black shapes at dusk.
